user.title: Choose an integration to update
user.description: Choose a custom integration that is already installed under custom_components. It can come from HACS or be copied in manually. Component Update does not list its own folder.

repo.title: GitHub repository
repo.description: Updates `{folder}` from this repository. Use a repository URL or owner/repo. A token is required for private repositories and recommended for public ones so GitHub does not rate-limit the checks.

data_description.branch: Branch Component Update should follow. The default is main.
data_description.token: Fine-grained personal access token with Contents set to Read-only. Leave empty for a public repository.

schedule.title: Update schedule
schedule.description: `{repo}` is checked on the schedule below. Manual mode reports an update and waits. Automatic mode downloads it. Home Assistant still needs a restart after an install.

reauth_confirm.title: Update GitHub token
reauth_confirm.description: GitHub rejected the token used for `{repo}` ({folder}).

error.invalid_url: Enter a github.com repository URL or owner/repo. Do not put the token in the URL.
error.invalid_auth: GitHub rejected the token, or the token cannot read this repository.
error.repo_not_found: Repository not found. If it is private, the token needs access to it.
error.branch_not_found: That branch was not found in the repository.
error.manifest_not_found: Could not find this integration's manifest.json in the repository.
error.manifest_mismatch: The repository manifest domain does not match the selected folder.
error.rate_limited: GitHub rate limit reached. Add a token or try again later.
error.archive_invalid: The repository archive could not be installed.
error.automatic_needs_interval: Automatic updates need a scheduled check. Choose hourly, daily, weekly, or another interval.
error.unknown: Something went wrong. See the logs.

abort.already_configured: That integration folder is already managed by Component Update.
abort.no_integrations: No custom integrations were found in custom_components. Install one from HACS or copy it in manually first.
abort.unknown: Something went wrong. See the logs.

init.title: Component Update options
init.description: Updating `{folder}` from `{repo}`. Leave the token empty to keep the token that is already saved.

data_description.token: Leave empty to keep the current token.

options.manual: Manual — report the update, install when I choose
options.automatic: Automatic — download the update when a check finds one

restart_required.title: Restart required to finish the update
restart_required.description: Component Update wrote a new version of `{name}`. Restart Home Assistant to load the new code.

rollback_paused.title: Rolled back and updates are paused
rollback_paused.description: Component Update installed an older version of `{name}` and paused updates. This folder stays on that version until you turn off Updates paused or install the latest version. Restart Home Assistant to load the new code.

check_updates.name: Check for updates
check_updates.description: Check the GitHub repositories configured in Component Update.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Integration folder to check. Leave empty to check every Component Update entry.

install_update.name: Install update
install_update.description: Download the latest commit for one folder and clear Updates paused.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Integration folder configured in Component Update.

rollback.name: Roll back
rollback.description: Install a tag or commit for one folder and turn Updates paused on.

folder.name: Folder
folder.description: Integration folder configured in Component Update.

version.name: Version
version.description: Tag name or commit SHA to install.
